caption: Filter on a list in a page: a searchable menu of what the list can be filtered by — its folders, callout kind, when pages were written or edited, and every page property the list's pages hold.
Pick Status: its values as a checklist with how many pages hold each. Ticking Open applies at once — the list narrows behind the menu and the chip appears. No Apply button.
Click a chip to change it: the same picker opens under the chip, with is, is not, is empty and is not empty.
× on a chip takes that filter away; the list widens at once and focus moves to the next chip, or to Filter.
Clear takes every filter away; the list shows all its pages again and the search words, if any, stay.
Two filters: a page must match both. The head counts what is shown, 2 of 6 pages.
Edited or Written: fixed choices only — Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last year, Any time. No typed dates.
Search this list: the only typed field. Its words narrow the list together with the chips, and Esc empties it.
The same chips on every view. On a Board grouped by Status, a column whose pages are all filtered out shows its heading with 0 and stays, so a card can still be dragged into it.
Nothing matches: one quiet line and Clear filters, in the list's own place; the chips stay so one can be changed.
Kept in the page: open it again and the chips are as they were. The ```view fence holds one filter: line each (shown here as the file holds it).
A filter whose value is gone (its folder deleted, a property removed): the chip shows the value struck and 'gone'; the list ignores it; × takes it away. Nothing is changed on disk until then.
The Questions list in the side list: All, Question and Answered stay as built; + Filter beside them adds a Folder or Book chip from the same picker.
Ctrl+K: the same chips under the search field narrow the one search — a kind (Pages, Questions, Key points, Notes, Folders) and a folder. Esc clears the words first, then closes.
An opened folder with many saves: + Filter offers what its saves are — a kind of save (verse, word, page, search) and a book — as chips over the folder's own order.
Phone and narrow panes: the chips stay on one line and scroll sideways; Filter and a chip's picker open as a bottom sheet with the same checklist.
